summary:
A new issue emerged with the fasterq_dump tool, where 6 tests failed because no fastq files were generated to build the expected output collection. This missing-file error likely points to a data-staging failure or an external data retrieval problem during job execution. Persistent issues remain stable compared to recent runs, including the long-standing infrastructure failure affecting 6 tools, requiring no immediate action.

The absence of database connection pool errors elsewhere in this run makes a server-overload explanation unlikely. This points instead toward an external network or data-staging mechanism failure rather than local server resource congestion.
